title: Quadratic Equations and Arithmetic Progressions
summary: Grade 10: solving quadratics by factorising and the formula, the discriminant, and nth terms and sums of APs.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Quadratic and linear patterns model changes in area, motion and money, and their forms reveal their solutions.

factual: How do you find the nth term of an AP?
conceptual: Why does the discriminant tell us the number of roots?
Why is the sum of an AP the average of the first and last terms times n?
debatable: Is a quadratic model always realistic for a real situation?
